_source.note: Skill Levels and Role Ability Ranks. STAT increases are out of scope for this file and must not be inferred from it: I.P. never buys a STAT.

_rules.skill: Raising a Skill to a new Level costs the new Level multiplied by the per-level cost: 20 I.P. a Level, so Handgun 4 to 5 is 100 I.P. A Skill flagged doubleCost in skills.json costs twice that, the same x2 flag the printed sheet marks.
_rules.levelling: One Level at a time. Raising a Skill several Levels costs the sum of each step, so the price climbs as the Skill does.
_rules.history: This file said 10 until October 2026, half the printed price. Levels bought at the old price stand; banked I.P. buys half what it did.
_rules.maximum: maxLevelInPlay in skills.json (10) is the ceiling; a Skill already there cannot be raised.
_rules.roleRank: Raising a Role Ability to a new Rank costs the new Rank multiplied by the per-Rank cost: 60 I.P. a Rank, so Rank 4 to 5 is 300 I.P. One Rank at a time, up to roleRankMax.
